courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 法國東歐高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」與「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；法國東歐高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" and "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of LGV Est europeenne must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦首代法國高速線線形與電氣介面；法國東歐高速鐵路則以跨區高速線分期銜接與控制互通為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on early French high speed alignment and electrical interfaces; LGV Est europeenne centres on phased high speed connections and control interoperability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」與「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到法國東歐高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「側風力與翻覆力矩」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” and “Communication delay and stale position”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to LGV Est europeenne, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Crosswind force and overturning moment", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 首爾—釜山高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」與「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；首爾—釜山高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" and "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Gyeongbu high-speed railway must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦首代法國高速線線形與電氣介面；首爾—釜山高速鐵路則以城際高速系統車輛升級與運轉介面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on early French high speed alignment and electrical interfaces; Gyeongbu high-speed railway centres on intercity high speed vehicle renewal and operating interfaces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」與「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到首爾—釜山高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「車門交換與停站時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” and “Gradient resistance and climbing power”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Gyeongbu high-speed railway, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Door exchange and dwell time", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 法國東南高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：1981 年：法國東南高速鐵路開始支援 TGV 營運；2023 年：SNCF 網路公司安全報告列示既有高速線背景。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以法國東南高速鐵路開創高速服務的歷史為背景，比較高速專用線和既有線銜接時的設計目標。課程將線形、牽引、分相、訊號與維護放在共同時間尺度，檢查一項速度提升是否需要多個子系統共同改變。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 1981: LGV Sud-Est began supporting TGV passenger operations; 2023: The SNCF infrastructure safety report documented the established high-speed network. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the introduction of French high-speed service on LGV Sud-Est to compare dedicated high-speed alignment with connections to conventional infrastructure. Place geometry, traction, neutral sections, signalling and maintenance on a common time axis. Investigate whether a speed increase demands coordinated changes in several subsystems rather than a single adjustment to motor output. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.
